name: create_entry_group
description:
Creates an Entry Group (or a Context Set when `type` is set to `"context-set"`) in Knowledge Catalog.

This is a long-running operation. To complete this task:
1. Capture the `operation_id` (the last segment of the `name` field) from the response of this tool.
2. Poll the `get_operation` tool using `project_id`, `location`, and this `operation_id` until `done` is true.

description.description: Optional. Plain-text summary description of the Entry Group or Context Set.

displayName.description: Optional. User-friendly display name of the Entry Group or Context Set.

entryGroupId.description: Required. The ID of the Entry Group to create (for example, `finance-context-set`). Must conform to RFC-1034 (lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens; 1-63 characters).

labels.description: Optional. User-defined labels for the Entry Group or Context Set.

location.description: Required. The Google Cloud location where the Entry Group will reside (for example, `us-central1` or `global`).

projectId.description: Required. The Google Cloud project ID that will contain the Entry Group.

type.description: Optional. Set to `"context-set"` to create a Context Set (which provisions a discoverable representative entry in `@dataplex` and grants the creator `roles/dataplex.entryGroupOwner`), or leave empty for a standard custom Entry Group.
